host:      (anonymised)
captured:  2026-08-08T18:38:36Z
client:    Darwin 25.5.0
transport: ssh + powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand

Output as it arrived over SSH. Structure is verbatim — key order, enum
values, /Date(ms)/ serialisation, CRLF line endings and UTF-8 non-ASCII
text are all exactly what the server sent.

Identities are not verbatim. The capture script replaces the computer
name with DESKTOP-EXAMPLE, the account with TESTUSER, routable IPv4 with
192.0.2.14 and link-local interface identifiers with a fixed value,
because these files are public and none of it is what a parser reads.
Loopback and 169.254 addresses are kept: they are identical on every
machine and the exposed-binding logic is tested against them.
